Market participants will need to update legal agreements, policies, and collateral management systems before the June 2026 deadline. corrected_fields.market_structure_context: The document provides detailed market structure guidance on repo market risk management. Key elements include: (1) haircuts should reflect counterparty credit risk, liquidity risk, and market risks; (2) legally enforceable documentation required for margining regime including timing, frequency, thresholds, valuation, and close-out provisions; (3) netting agreements and portfolio margining can supplement but not replace haircuts; (4) centrally cleared repos already compliant; (5) repo intermediated into central clearing still requires bilateral risk management between client and facilitating participant.
